```{r general functions}
create_VoronoiDiagram <- function(Hypothesis){
  X = Hypothesis$x
  Y = Hypothesis$y
  dxy  <- deldir(X,Y,rw=c(0,100,0,100))
  tiles <- tile.list(dxy)
  return(tiles)
}

evaluate_OwnershipVariability <- function(A_rating, B_rating, tiles){
  #ownership_ratings: participant rating for A (y) and B (x)'s ownerships
  #voronoi_specifications: a hypothesis with two lists of centroid coords
  i <- which.tile(B_rating, A_rating,tiles)
  return(i)
}
```

```{r voronoi diagram areas}
x_1 = 18.37710
x_3 = 81.62270	
y_1 = 18.37710
y_3 = 81.62270	
H = data.frame(x=c(x_1,x_1,50,x_3,x_3),
        y=c(y_1,y_3,50,y_1,y_3))
chosen_tiles <- create_VoronoiDiagram(H)
    
area1 <- chosen_tiles$pt.1$area
area2 <- chosen_tiles$pt.2$area
area3 <- chosen_tiles$pt.3$area
area4 <- chosen_tiles$pt.4$area
area5 <- chosen_tiles$pt.5$area
```

# Experiment 1
```{r read in data & partition & export for further analyses}
exp1_Main_conditions<- read_csv("./data/exp-1/11.exp1-main-conditions.csv")
exp1_Baseline_conditions<- read_csv("./data/exp-1/12.exp1-baseline-conditions.csv")

exp1_data_voronoi <- exp1_Main_conditions%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A,B, chosen_tiles))

exp1_data_voronoi_baseline <- exp1_Baseline_conditions%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(which_Voronoi_group = evaluate_OwnershipVariability(A,B, chosen_tiles))

#write_csv(exp1_data_voronoi,"./data/exp-1/13.exp1-main-conditions-voronoi.csv")
#write_csv(exp1_data_voronoi_baseline,"./data/exp-1/14.exp1-baseline-conditions-voronoi.csv")
```


# Experiments 1 & 2
```{r (SI) Figure. 2 - voronoi figures for each ownership theory cluster}
cluster_mentalistic_groups <- read_csv("./data/exp-1and2/00.exp1and2-mentalistic-group-voronoi.csv")
cluster_physical_groups <- read_csv("./data/exp-1and2/01.exp1and2-physical-group-voronoi.csv")

rbPal <- colorRampPalette(c('grey','blue'))
cluster_1_groups_long <- cluster_mentalistic_groups%>%gather(which_Voronoi_group,perc,`1`:`5`)%>%mutate(perc=round(perc,2))
cluster_1_groups_long$color_code <- rbPal(100)[round(cluster_1_groups_long$perc*100)+1]
cluster_2_groups_long <- cluster_physical_groups%>%gather(which_Voronoi_group,perc,`1`:`5`)%>%mutate(perc=round(perc,2))
cluster_2_groups_long$color_code <- rbPal(100)[round(cluster_2_groups_long$perc*100)+1]

plot_Voronoi_byTrial <- function(which_trial, cluster_data){
  trial_data_color <- cluster_data%>%ungroup()%>%filter(trial_condition==which_trial)%>%select(color_code,perc)
  plot(chosen_tiles, pch = 20, close=TRUE, showpoints=FALSE, fillcol = trial_data_color$color_code,xlab="Second agent rating", ylab="Original owner rating")
  text(H$x, H$y, labels = trial_data_color$perc, col="black")
}

## Saved as pdf files 4 x 4 inches
# cluster 1 mentalistic
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("1 agent,accidental", cluster_1_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup", cluster_1_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway", cluster_1_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup", cluster_1_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway", cluster_1_groups_long)

# cluster 2 physical possession
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("1 agent,accidental", cluster_2_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup", cluster_2_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway", cluster_2_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup", cluster_2_groups_long)
plot_Voronoi_byTrial("2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway", cluster_2_groups_long)
```
